description: Named icon export library that maps Lucide-compatible icon names to Google Material Symbols via the Icon primitive. Provides 60+ named exports (X, Check, ChevronDown, Search, Trash, Plus, etc.) as drop-in replacements, enabling migration from Lucide to Material Symbols without changing import names.
useCases: Importing named icons (e.g., Check, Trash, Plus) throughout the design system and application
Replacing Lucide icon imports with Material Symbols equivalents without refactoring call sites
Providing a consistent icon vocabulary across all DS components
Extending the icon set by adding new createIcon entries to this file
